data.title: Reportage Hills
data.about:
Reportage Hills is an exceptional townhouse community nestled in the vibrant Dubailand area, offering a harmonious blend of style, functionality, and contemporary living. The community features a selection of 3 to 5-bedroom townhouses, each crafted with unmatched finishing and elegant designs. Spread across an expansive 232,242 sq.m plot, R. Hills by  by Reportage Properties comprises 902 meticulously designed homes that reflect sophistication and modernity. This thoughtfully planned community ensures a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle, perfectly attuned to the needs of modern families.

Each townhouse at Reportage Hills at Dubailand, Dubai is equipped with premium features and finishes that elevate everyday living. Homes boast customized R. signature accessories, private balconies or terraces, fully tiled bathrooms, and built-in wardrobes in bedrooms. Double-glazed windows, central air conditioning, and satellite connectivity ensure comfort and convenience, while high-speed fiber optic internet access keeps residents connected. With private parking for each unit and contemporary kitchens fitted with cabinets and countertops, every detail of these homes has been carefully designed to provide the perfect blend of practicality and luxury.

characteristics_module.title: Reportage Hills at Dubailand : A Blend of Elegance and Functionality
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location in Dubailand: Reportage Hills in Dubailand, Dubai offers a vibrant community setting with seamless access to Dubai’s major landmarks and attractions.
  • Exceptional Townhouse Collection: Reportage Hills by Reportage Properties in Dubailand features 3 to 5-bedroom townhouses, designed with unmatched elegance and functionality.
  • Spacious Living Spaces: With 902 townhouses spread across a 232,242 sq.m plot, each home is thoughtfully crafted to provide ample space and comfort.
  • Modern Features and Finishes: Equipped with R. signature accessories, double-glazed windows, private balconies, and built-in wardrobes, every detail reflects sophistication.
  • Family-Centric Amenities: Residents of Reportage Hills at Dubailand can enjoy world-class facilities, including a swimming pool, gym, kids' play area, and landscaped parks.
  • Sustainable and Stylish Living: Reportage Hills by Reportage Properties in Dubailand combines eco-friendly designs with contemporary aesthetics to create the perfect modern lifestyle.
  • Unmatched Connectivity: Conveniently located, it provides easy access to Dubai Sports City, Global Village, and Al Maktoum International Airport, making it ideal for families and professionals.

location_tile.title: R. Hills at Dubailand: Your Journey to Refined Living
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Dubailand is a vibrant and dynamic community known for its family-friendly atmosphere and world-class attractions. Offering expansive parks, entertainment hubs, and exceptional amenities, it has become a sought-after destination for residents and investors alike. With its seamless connectivity to key landmarks like Global Village, Dubai Sports City, and Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubailand perfectly balances urban convenience with tranquil living, making it the ideal place to call home.

  • 5 minutes to Dubai Sports City
  • 10 minutes to Dubai Investments Park
  • 15 minutes to Cityland Mall
  • 15 minutes to Global Village
  • 15 minutes to Plation Equestrian & Polo Club
  • 20 minutes driving to Al Maktoum International Airport
